name: enterprise-architect-skills
description: Skills that help enterprise architects turn messy business cases into decisions executives can act on.

plugins.name: enterprise-architect-skills
plugins.description: Step-by-step skills for enterprise architecture cases: scope and objectives, a political stakeholder map, key diagnosis findings, a capability-based architecture proposal and the one-to-one conversations that align every stakeholder before the committee, the governance that keeps it moving, and the next steps with a plan B. Plus one skill that unifies the closed points into a single Excel workbook. No made-up numbers.
